Permits & License Committee  October 9, 2025
Minutes  Page 1 of 6

  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  October 9, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted City Hall; Community Room # A 1St Floor
On October 9, 2025 at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh , Administration Department
  Angel – Leon Martell, Planning Department.
  Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Crystal McGlover, Emergency Services/ Public Safety Department

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley , City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on September 25, 2025

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Camille Delaney- MCNeil on behalf of Los Angeles Philharmonic, Inc. to host a Gracias
  Gustavo Community Block Party Event at 101 S La Brea Ave; Beckmen Yola Center Parking
  Lot; Private Property; on Saturday, October 11, 2025, from 10:00 a.m. – 4;00 p.m.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1) day event within Beckmen YOLA
  parking lot and on Queen Street. Subject to Public Works approval for use/closure of the
  right-of-way; Approved; This is a joint city event. There will be one (1) sgt and three (3)
  police officers deployed for public safety, five (5) TCO's for traffic control and three (3) CH
  security officers to assist with monitoring the parking structure. The applicant will be
  responsible for hiring adequate professional licensed security guards to assist IPD with any
  potential crowd control; onditions for amplified sound: Manage noise reading. Comply with
  IMC 5-27 and IMC 5-29; None conditions for Fire Approval;Maintain site at all times, ensuring
  site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members
  working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face
  mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State
  health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 0046564)
 Permits & License Committee  October 9, 2025
Minutes  Page 2 of 6

Item #2:  Tracy Yeager on behalf of Greater Deliverance Church of God in Christ to host a
  Thanksgiving Outreach Event at 6741 West Blvd; Greater Deliverance COGIC;; Private
  Property; on Saturday, November 22, 2025, from 11:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY; Approval for 1 day event within church parking lot; Approved; Applicant
  to hire a min. of 4 professional / licensed security guards for the safety of attendees /
  volunteers. Security staff shall wear reflective vest to be readily identifiable. IPD watch
  commander will be notified and extra patrol provided as time permits; Code Enforcemt
  :Conditions for amplified sound: Manage noise reading. Comply with IMC 5-27 and IMC 5-
  29; None conditions Fire Approval Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00406475)

Item #3:  Dionne Faulk on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Snowy Winter Wonderland Event at
  2900 W Imperial Hwy; Crenshaw and Imperial Plaza Shopping Center Parking Lot;Private
  Property; on, Sunday, December 7, 2025, from 12:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one (1) day event within Crenshaw Imperial Plaza parking
  lot. Applicant responsible for crowd control; Approved; IPD and TCO's will be deployed at
  this event for public safety and traffic control. **Meridian Barriers maybe required for this
  event.** None Code Enforcement conditions; None conditions for Fire Approval; Maintain site
  at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant
  and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal
  hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department
  and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously (Activity No. 00406541)

New Business License Renewal Request (s):
Item #4:  Shadonna Shelby DBA Cherubeem Hair Specialist to operate as a Hair/ Nail Salon at 1237
  South District Drive Suite # 110. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE
  FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Payment of annual business license and tax fees;Business
  owner must possess and maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State
  Board of Barbering & Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists
  operating within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board of
  Barbering & Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating
  within the establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City; Business
  owner shall provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies of
  applicable state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the
  establishment to the Finance Department; Parties, social events or gatherings of any type is
  strictly prohibited; Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including
  cannabis activity) is not permitted on the premises;Massage therapy of any part of the body
  is not permitted; Subject to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or any
  Peace Officer at any time to ensure compliance; Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.
 Permits & License Committee  October 9, 2025
Minutes  Page 3 of 6

  Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your
  business license and any future business license application requests. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00406536)

Item #5:  Tunisia Johnson DBA Peach Hospitality Adult Residential Care to operate as a Nursing /
  Healthcare Facility at 3501 W. 118th Street; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO
  THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license renewal and tax
  fees; Applicant must have accurate employment records on all employees at all times;Not to
  exceed six (6) tenants/patients without a city approved Special Use Permit.Business owner
  and/or facility is subject to random inspection by any city, county, or state Police and/or Code
  Enforcement officers during hours of operation to ensure patient(s) good welfare, health and
  safety; Business owner/employer is responsible for maintaining accurate and updated
  employee records for all employee’s;Business owner/facility is strictly prohibited from hiring
  or employing any person registered under California Penal Code Section 290 PC or any
  person that may pose a public safety risk/threat to patients or other employees at the location;
  and Adhere to all State, Federal, County Laws and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  Business License application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00406476)

Item #6:  Elijah Davis DBA Legendary Cuts to operate as a Barbershop at 1237 South District Dr. #
  126; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must possess and
  maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City; Business owner shall
  provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies of applicable state
  licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the establishment to the
  Finance Department;Parties, social events or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited;
  Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis activity) is not
  permitted on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted; Subject
  to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or any Peace Officer at any
  time to ensure compliance; Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules
  and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  business license application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00406486)

  unanimously

New Tobacco Retailer License Renewal Request (s):

Item #8:  Jathiya Muhammad DBA All & One Mini Mart to operate as a Tobacco Retailer at 209 E
  Nutwood St; This Business License has been APPROVED with the following condition
  set forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of Inglewood
  Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS FOR
  BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere to all
  State and Federal Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 32 Square Feet or 25%
  of total retail floor areaSales or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of
  Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored
  Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored
  Smokeless Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own
  Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are Strictly
  Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21
  is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have
  a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales or display of any type of
  weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun guns is strictly
  prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their designees are
  subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time of the day or
  night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random inspections is to
  enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by the City of
  Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of Equalization
  Tobacco Retailers license must be current;Approval for retail sales of tobacco products within
  existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah products) to
  minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products
  SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction of underage tobacco
  use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal certificates if applicable;NO

  of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the use of or illegal sales or cultivation of

  PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC. APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE
  BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR NIGHT) OF OPERATION. Motion carried
